evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC error handling across src/rpc/protocol.h and various RPC endpoints.
rationale: The PR standardizes RPCErrorCode values across RPC endpoints and parsing to ensure self-consistent error responses for invalid arguments and out-of-range numeric inputs. As the author notes, existing mismatches are 'perfectly fine, because they should be hit rarely in production,' making this a worthwhile but deferrable interface consistency improvement.
